name: per-workspace wallpaper x the greeting's ink
why: a bright wallpaper on ONE workspace flips html.bg-light, and the greeting keys all three of its ink frames on that class
detail: ws A has-bg bg-dark -> rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.46)   ws B has-bg bg-light -> rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)

name: wallpaper rotation x the once-a-day type-out
why: both fire on the FIRST open of a day - rotation swaps the ground under the line while the line is typing itself in
detail: ground is image (has-bg bg-image), greeting rendered "Good evening", arrival observed this load: false

name: the bookmarks panel x the import panel
why: both create shortcuts, and only one of them was written with duplicate detection in mind
detail: both route through Storage.addShortcut; the IMPORT panel counts duplicates before it writes, the bookmarks panel's per-row + does NOT - it adds unconditionally. Neither corrupts the other; the asymmetry is real and is a product question, not a defect.

name: content arriving in workspace B while viewing workspace A
why: an import targets a workspace, the wallpaper is keyed by workspace, and the page re-renders on any storage change - so a naive implementation repaints A with B's wallpaper or shows B's groups
detail: B's groups 2 -> 3, still viewing A: true, B's wallpaper intact: true, root has-bg bg-dark -> has-bg bg-dark, B's new group visible from A: false

name: the greeting explosion x a full Home re-render mid-flight
why: switching tabs and back rebuilds Home entirely; if that happens during the explosion the heading could come back and the debris be orphaned
detail: debris survived the re-render: true, heading stayed gone: true, date still present: true, note still present: true
